items.title: Verstappen wins; McLaren secure a double podium
items.summary: Verstappen beat Norris by 0.639 seconds and Piastri by 1.529. Antonelli qualified first but started sixth after a PU penalty; a late power issue left him fourth. Russell hit the barrier while fighting back and finished ninth.
items.why_it_matters: Separate qualifying order from the penalty-adjusted grid and final classification. The full official session tables are now available; FP1 had no timed laps.

items.title: Leclerc penalised after further contact with Hamilton
items.summary: Leclerc received a 10-second penalty for the Turn 7 collision with Hamilton. Hamilton finished seventh and Leclerc tenth. Vasseur criticised the clash after the team's previous discussions following Mexico.
items.why_it_matters: A continuing team-relations storyline for Qatar, not evidence that new team orders have been announced.

items.title: Perez has a five-place drop at his next race
items.summary: The stewards found Perez wholly responsible for contact with Câmara at Turn 14. Because Perez retired, the unserved time penalty was converted to a five-place drop at his next race.
items.why_it_matters: Qatar is the expected next application. This is a grid penalty, not a five-second race penalty, and the Vegas PU sanctions must not be carried over a second time.
